title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into endpoint summary data. When another user accesses the Time Center dashboard and selects an affected row, the system may execute attacker-controlled SPL commands with the permissions of the selecting user. This occurs because the Time Center dashboard does not properly escape endpoint summary values before using them in drilldown searches, potentially allowing unauthorized data access and modification.
